before.title: Notes from the allotment
blocks: # Growing beans on a north-facing plot
Last updated 3 days ago
Runner beans tolerate more shade than most people expect. On our plot they get five hours of direct light and still crop well into September.
The trick is a tall support so the vines can climb into the light, and a thick mulch to keep the roots cool and damp.
## What we planted
- Scarlet Emperor
- White Lady
- Painted Lady

before.title: Why I still write in plain text
blocks: # Why I still write in plain text
Plain text files are the one format I can open on every machine I have owned since 1998 — and they still open today.
A friend called it “the cockroach of formats”. It’s meant as a compliment.
Notes, drafts, and lists all live in one folder, synced by a tool that doesn’t care what is inside.

before.title: Fixing a squeaky door hinge
blocks: # Fixing a squeaky door hinge
A squeaky hinge almost always means the pin is dry. Lift the pin out with a nail and a hammer, tapping from below.
Wipe the pin clean with a cloth, then coat it with a thin layer of petroleum jelly or a light machine oil.
Push the pin back in, swing the door a dozen times and wipe off any excess that squeezes out at the top.
If the squeak comes back within a week, the hinge itself may be bent and worth replacing.

A squeaky hinge almost always means the pin is dry. Lift the pin out with a nail and a hammer, tapping from below.
Wipe the pin clean with a cloth, then coat it with a thin layer of petroleum jelly or a light machine oil.
Push the pin back in, swing the door a dozen times and wipe off any excess that squeezes out at the top.

before.title: Starting seeds indoors
blocks: # Starting seeds indoors
Starting seeds on a windowsill is cheap and fun, and it gives tomatoes and peppers the head start they need in a short summer.
## Light
A south-facing window is enough for most seedlings, but turn the trays every day so the stems grow straight.
## Water
Water from below by standing the tray in a dish for ten minutes. The compost should feel like a wrung-out sponge.
## Hardening off
Move the plants outside for an hour on the first day and add an hour each day for a week.

after.title: Starting seeds indoors
blocks: # Starting seeds indoors
After three failed springs, I finally worked out what my seedlings needed: more light than a windowsill gives, and far less water than I thought.
## Light
A cheap LED shop light hung ten centimetres above the trays beats any window. Run it for fourteen hours a day on a timer.
## Water
Water from below by standing the tray in a dish for ten minutes. The compost should feel like a wrung-out sponge.
## Hardening off
Move the plants outside for an hour on the first day and add an hour each day for a week.
